title: Quiz: Pseudo-classes and Pseudo-elements
description: Check your understanding of Pseudo-classes and Pseudo-elements.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: In CSS, /* */ marks a comment. Block comments use /* ... */.

questions.question: What does ::before do?
options: Inserts decorative content before the element
questions.correctAnswer: Inserts decorative content before the element

questions.question: True or False: Pseudo-elements style generated parts of elements.
What is the main purpose of the Pseudo-classes and Pseudo-elements technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements effectively.

questions.question: In CSS, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
